note: Rules for what reaches the website from Planning Center. The 'Website' tag in Planning Center decides what appears; these rules are a second safety net that runs even if something is tagged by mistake.
excludeNote: Outside groups that rent the building. They are not church events and must never appear on the church's website.
excludePatternsNote: Matched case-insensitively against the event name. These are private, pastoral or internal by nature. Even a correctly-tagged event whose name matches one of these is refused.
